note: All art is authored on a 4px pixel grid. Scale by integer factors with nearest-neighbour only.

panel/panel-frame.png.detail: rings from outside in: 4px #000, 4px #4e2f24, 4px #9a6651, 4px #000; then the panel fill with a 4px #33231d top highlight and 4px #150e0c bottom shadow; 32x32 gold corner brackets, 6px thick, inset 8px

panel/ornament-crest.png.anchor: top-center of the panel frame, bottom edge overlapping the frame by 4px

panel/ornament-crest-2_5x.png.note: pre-scaled 2.5x version used in the mock

buttons/btn-login-pressed.png.note: drop shadow removed; draw 6px lower than normal

scales.note: Two scales ship. Chrome is block art and is RE-EMITTED, never resampled; text and font sheets are 1px-grid typography and are always 1:1.
scales.source_4px: Root folders (panel/, widgets/, buttons/) — the original art on a 4px block grid. This is the design source.
scales.client_2px: derived-2px/ — the same chrome re-emitted on a 2px block grid, at the exact sizes data/styles/40-entergame.otui expects. This is what the client ships.
scales.rule: Chrome measurements in layout.json are for the 4px source; halve them for the client. Text measurements are NOT halved.
scales.detect: node tools/pixelui/blockscale.js detect <file>  — if it reports 1px (irregular), the file is text: do not rescale.

derived-2px/panel-frame.png.detail: rings 2px each: #000 / #4e2f24 / #9a6651 / #000; panel fill #231815 with 2px #33231d top highlight and 2px #150e0c bottom shadow; 16x16 gold corner brackets, 3px thick, inset 4px — all inside the 20px border

derived-2px/input-field.png.detail: border 8 keeps the gold ring, the ink ring AND the 4px top inner shadow inside the border, so the tiled centre is flat fill and the height is free. Border 6 pushes the shadow into the centre, where the engine repeats it.

derived-2px/input-field-active.png.note: outer ring swapped to #ebbf90 — the focus ring. Use $active, not $focus.

derived-2px/checkbox-off.png.note: pin left with image-rect; the row is the widget

derived-2px/ornament-crest-60x25.png.note: 4px blocks re-emitted at 5px (1.25x), phantom, centred on the panel's top edge

derived-2px/btn-login-pressed.png.note: drop shadow removed; draw 3px lower. Declare image-rect on the BASE too — updateStyle only reverts what the base declares.

derived_2px._how_built: Plates are rebuilt band by band at the new block thickness and the baked label is re-pasted at 1:1, centred — a button is never stretched or rescaled. Primary bands top-down: gold-dk 2, ink 2, gold-hi 2, gold fill 26, gold-mid 2, ink 2, gold-dk 2, drop shadow 4 (inset 4px, normal variant only).

eye_note: widgets/eye-open.png / eye-closed.png (28x20) are used at ~1:1 by LoginEyeToggle (29x21) — they are NOT halved.
